headline: Linn Mercy Toll Mounts; Wardens Retake Palantine Berm Lead
war_summary: Three hours have brought a change of fortune on the Linn Mercy front, where the Colonial tally has slipped to eight holdings and three ruins while the hourly butcher's bill there has passed a thousand a side — the war's heaviest exchange, centered on Outwich Ranch. In Palantine Berm the seesaw has tipped once more, the Wardens back in front four posts to three after fifty-odd ownership actions in a day. The Weathered Expanse map stands as this desk last reported it, four Colonial to three Warden with two posts in ruin, yet the guns there have not slackened. On the Nevish Line the Warden grip holds at seven to one, though losses on both sides accelerate past five hundred an hour. Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua has roared back to life after its lull, and fresh flashes are reported at Stonecradle's Trammel Pool. The Gutter rests quiet in Warden hands. Day 598 of the war; thirty-four victory towns required; no victor named.
